styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Upper Town lanes, churches and café terraces.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Markets, štrukli and long dinners out.

styles.label: History
styles.blurb: Museums, old walls and the war story.

stays.why: Flat, central grid of parks and museums. Walk to everything; good tram links.
The old Upper Town: quiet lanes, St Mark's Church and the Stone Gate on your doorstep.
Around Ban Jelačić Square and the Dolac market. Busiest spot for food and nightlife.
By the main train and bus stations. Easy airport bus and day trips; 10–15 minutes' walk to the centre.

food: Try štrukli (baked cheese pastry), sarma and punjene paprike at a konoba (tavern).
Dolac market, just above the main square: fruit, cheese and honey in the morning; go early.
Grab a cheap lunch of burek or čevapi from a bakery or grill; expect roughly €5–10.
Coffee is a ritual: sit at a terrace for a small espresso or a 'bijela kava'.
For nightlife food, look around Tkalčićeva street and the Lower Town; prices vary, check menus.
more_time: Swap a city day for the Plitvice Lakes: long day trip, book transport and tickets ahead.
Take the short trip to Samobor for cream cakes and easy hill walks.
Ride the cable car to Sljeme on Medvednica for views and a walk, if the weather is clear.

recommend.why: Two nights covers the Upper and Lower Town, the main museums and a proper food evening; add a night for a day trip.

month_notes: January: cold, highs near 5°C and lows around -2°C. Pack a warm coat; museums and cafés are the plan.
February: still cold, highs near 9°C. Fewer crowds and lower prices; watch for ice in the morning.
March: mild at 12°C with about 9 rain days. Bring a rain jacket and walk the centre between showers.
April: pleasant at 17°C. Good month for walking and terraces; keep an umbrella handy.
May: warm at 21°C but the wettest month, about 15 rain days. Plan indoor backups.
June: warm and sunny, highs near 26°C. Great for long days outside and evening terraces.
July: hot at 28°C with mild nights. Do sights in the morning; sit in shade at midday.
August: as hot as July, around 28°C. Similar advice: early starts and shaded breaks.
September: comfortable at 22°C. One of the best months for walking and eating outside.
October: cooler at 17°C with about 9 rain days. Bring layers and a light rain jacket.
November: chilly at 11°C. Fewer tourists; good for museums and cafés.
December: cold at 6°C. Pack warm clothes; the Advent markets are the main draw, check dates on the day.

climate_guide.summary: Continental climate: cold winters, warm summers, and rain spread through the year, wettest in May.

items.title: Best time: May to September
items.text: Warm days from 21°C to 28°C. June and September are the sweet spots; July and August are hottest.

items.title: May is the wettest month
items.text: About 15 rain days. Pack a rain jacket and keep indoor plans ready.

items.title: Winter is cold
items.text: January highs near 5°C and lows around -2°C. December and February are only a little milder.

items.title: Layers all year
items.text: Evenings cool down in summer. Bring a light layer in warm months and a warm coat from November to March.

items.title: Summer heat is manageable
items.text: July and August peak near 28°C with mild nights around 18°C. Sightsee early and rest at midday.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Comfortable walking shoes, a rain jacket, sunglasses, and warm layers for winter. An umbrella helps in spring and autumn.

transit.best: Walk the centre and use trams for longer hops; kiosk or app tickets are cheapest.

modes.text: No metro. Trams are the main public transport.
Trams run 24 hours: 15 day lines and 4 night lines. Buy tickets at kiosks or the MOJ ZET app, cheaper than from the driver. A short 30-minute ticket costs about €0.53 at a kiosk.
ZET buses cover the suburbs and use the same tickets as trams.
Taxis, Bolt and Uber all work. Airport rides cost about €14–20.
Not needed in the centre; walking and trams cover the sights. Consider only for trips outside the city.
The centre is best walked. Public bikes cost about €0.66 per 30 minutes.
